_about: Stage 5 script. One beat = one scene. vo is spoken (display spelling; brand pronunciations live in campaign.brand.say). voice.mode: recorded (you read the lines; the built-in files engine), clone (ref = a voice in voices/), design (pick a ref first), preset (name = an engine's stock voice) or none; voice.engine overrides campaign.voice_engine. Shape: hook by 2.5 s, first value by 6 s, re-hook half-way, payoff keeps the hook's promise (references/05-script.md). Variants replace beat B01 only, so hooks can be A/B tested on one body. recipe (mvflib/recipes.json) names what the script is built from; beats[].material cites the 00-material item ids each beat stands on (mvf material ls), the way facts cites F ids. Delete this _about when done.
value: what the viewer walks away with

beats.visual: frame 0: the most interesting picture of the video, already moving (the result, the surprise); never a logo
first value by 6 s: the real product screen, its name in frame, pushed in on the control that matters
re-hook about half-way: the next, bigger thing
one soft line over the payoff picture: product name + handle, no logo card
